overall_summary: THINK FAST DAILY shows strong audience engagement potential on geography, space, and history quiz formats, notably seen in high-performing videos like 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' and 'Which Came First?'. However, recent zero-view uploads indicate possible algorithmic suppression or timing misalignment. Viewers favor clear curiosity gaps and high view percentages (>60% on top performers). To drive growth, focus on high-retention topics, optimize publish schedules, and avoid repetitive questions.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' achieved 421 views, 17 likes, and 66.91% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more distinct, comparative geography challenges with clear visual clues.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Which Came First? 🧠 History Trivia Quiz!' achieved 249 views, 6 likes, and an exceptional 135.81% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Create fresh historical chronology and sequence-based challenges to capitalize on high re-watchability.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'What Color Is a Sunset on Mars? 🪐 Space Quiz!' garnered 417 views, 7 likes, and 51.68% average view percentage.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate lesser-known planetary facts into quick A/B/C/D formats.

improvements.evidence: Multiple variations of line-length and optical illusion questions ('Which Line Is Actually Longer?', 'Can your brain beat this optical illusion?') show diminishing returns.
improvements.action: Diversify away from identical optical illusion questions and introduce fresh logic and math puzzles.

improvements.evidence: Recent uploads like 'Space fans, get this right! What is the closest star to Earth after the Sun?' recorded 0 views, pointing to potential upload timing or metadata issues.
improvements.action: Refine posting schedules and ensure robust tag/title optimization before publishing.

retention_insights.evidence: 'Which Came First? 🧠 History Trivia Quiz!' maintained audience watch ratios above 1.5 through 25% of the video, resulting in 135.81% average view percentage.
retention_insights.action: Use strong hook phrasing that invites a second look or comparison right at the 0-3 second mark.

retention_insights.evidence: 'The Physics Ring Puzzle!' dropped slightly in the first 5% but stabilized to achieve 60.23% average view percentage.
retention_insights.action: Front-load the visual demonstration of the puzzle in the first second to minimize early drop-off.

best_posting_windows.reason: Observed successful high-performing uploads like 'Which Country Has The Most Lakes?' published around 06:45 UTC.
Observed successful high-engagement space and history videos published around this window.

avoid_or_limit.reason: Audience fatigue is evident from multiple nearly identical IQ and perception challenges.
